implementation_directions: src/ui/NewProjectDialog.tsx (new component): gates the handleNew flow. Fields: (a) Project Title (text input; maps to ecm:name in created project document); (b) Subject of the graph (text input; maps to iao:isAbout array; helper text shows example IRI). Secondary action: 'Skip — use placeholder' (per FR-U001 amendment 'UI MAY defer the prompt to first save attempt'; creates project with ecm:UnspecifiedSubjectMatter placeholder but DOES NOT show MISSING_REALIST_ANCHOR banner — design philosophy: don't accuse user of skipping the optional prompt). Use src/ui/Dialog.tsx primitive.

(a) handleNew() opens NewProjectDialog instead of immediately creating project; on dialog Confirm, creates project with the dialog's Title + Subject IRI; on dialog Skip, creates project with ecm:UnspecifiedSubjectMatter placeholder

(c) Banner-area replacement: a soft guidance affordance — 'No subject set. Add a subject in Project Settings.' style — only when isAboutState === 'missing'. Style: muted text, no red, no error iconography. Optional: link to Project Settings dialog
